name: Complexity.Planar.Linked.countP_lt_of_mono
Complexity.Planar.Linked.exists_stable
statement:
theorem exists_stable (x : Fin n) :
    ∃ j, j < n ∧ ∀ y, G.linked (j + 1) x y = G.linked j x y

name: Complexity.Planar.Linked.linked_mono
statement:
theorem linked_mono {k k' : Nat} (hk : k ≤ k') {x y : Fin n} (h : G.linked k x y = true) :
    G.linked k' x y = true

name: Complexity.Planar.Linked.linked_mono_succ
statement:
theorem linked_mono_succ {k : Nat} {x y : Fin n} (h : G.linked k x y = true) :
    G.linked (k + 1) x y = true

name: Complexity.Planar.Linked.linked_refl
statement: theorem linked_refl (k : Nat) (x : Fin n) : G.linked k x x = true

name: Complexity.Planar.Linked.linked_stable
statement:
theorem linked_stable {k : Nat} {x y : Fin n} (h : G.linked k x y = true) :
    G.linked n x y = true

name: Complexity.Planar.Linked.linked_step
statement:
theorem linked_step {k : Nat} {x z y : Fin n} (h : G.linked k x z = true) (hs : Step G z y) :
    G.linked (k + 1) x y = true

name: Complexity.Planar.Linked.linked_succ
statement:
theorem linked_succ (k : Nat) (x y : Fin n) :
    G.linked (k + 1) x y = true ↔
      G.linked k x y = true ∨ ∃ z, G.linked k x z = true ∧ Step G z y

name: Complexity.Planar.Linked.linked_trans
statement:
theorem linked_trans {a b : Nat} {x y z : Fin n} (h1 : G.linked a x y = true)
    (h2 : G.linked b y z = true) : G.linked (a + b) x z = true

name: Complexity.Planar.Linked.linked_zero
statement: theorem linked_zero (x y : Fin n) : G.linked 0 x y = true ↔ x = y

name: Complexity.Planar.Linked.reachCount_grows
statement:
theorem reachCount_grows (x : Fin n) (k : Nat)
    (h : ¬ ∀ y, G.linked (k + 1) x y = G.linked k x y) :
    reachCount G x k < reachCount G x (k + 1)

name: Complexity.Planar.Linked.reachCount_le
statement: theorem reachCount_le (x : Fin n) (k : Nat) : reachCount G x k ≤ n

name: Complexity.Planar.Linked.reachCount_zero
statement: theorem reachCount_zero (x : Fin n) : 1 ≤ reachCount G x 0

name: Complexity.Planar.Linked.stable_forever
statement:
theorem stable_forever {x : Fin n} {k : Nat} (h : ∀ y, G.linked (k + 1) x y = G.linked k x y) :
    ∀ j y, G.linked (k + j) x y = G.linked k x y

name: Complexity.Planar.Linked.stable_from
statement:
theorem stable_from {x : Fin n} {k : Nat} (h : ∀ y, G.linked (k + 1) x y = G.linked k x y) :
    ∀ j y, G.linked (k + j + 1) x y = G.linked (k + j) x y

name: Complexity.Planar.Linked.stable_succ
statement:
theorem stable_succ {x : Fin n} {k : Nat} (h : ∀ y, G.linked (k + 1) x y = G.linked k x y) :
    ∀ y, G.linked (k + 2) x y = G.linked (k + 1) x y

name: Complexity.Planar.componentCount_le
statement:
theorem componentCount_le {n : Nat} (G : Hypermap n) (R : Fin n → Bool)
    (h : ∀ x, R x = false → ∃ y : Fin n, y.val < x.val ∧ ∃ k, G.linked k x y = true) :
    G.componentCount ≤ (List.finRange n).countP R

name: Complexity.Planar.countP_finRange_val
statement:
theorem countP_finRange_val {n : Nat} (P : Nat → Bool) :
    (List.finRange n).countP (fun x => P x.val) = (List.range n).countP P

name: Complexity.Planar.countP_range_even
statement:
theorem countP_range_even (E : Nat) :
    (List.range (2 * E)).countP (fun d => d % 2 == 0) = E

name: Complexity.Planar.cycleCount_eq
statement:
theorem cycleCount_eq {n : Nat} (p : Fin n → Fin n) :
    cycleCount p = (List.finRange n).countP (CycleMin p)

name: Complexity.Planar.cycleCount_ge
statement:
theorem cycleCount_ge {n : Nat} {β : Type} (p : Fin n → Fin n) (φ : Fin n → β)
    (hφ : ∀ x, φ (p x) = φ x) (xs : List (Fin n)) (hnd : (xs.map φ).Nodup) :
    xs.length ≤ cycleCount p

name: Complexity.Planar.cycleCount_graphEdge_ge
statement:
theorem cycleCount_graphEdge_ge {E : Nat} {edge : Fin (2 * E) → Fin (2 * E)}
    (h : IsGraphEdge edge) : E ≤ cycleCount edge

name: Complexity.Planar.cycleCount_graphEdge_le
statement:
theorem cycleCount_graphEdge_le {E : Nat} {edge : Fin (2 * E) → Fin (2 * E)}
    (h : IsGraphEdge edge) : cycleCount edge ≤ E

name: Complexity.Planar.exists_least_label
statement:
theorem exists_least_label {n : Nat} {β : Type} (φ : Fin n → β) (x : Fin n) :
    ∃ m : Fin n, φ m = φ x ∧ ∀ z : Fin n, φ z = φ x → m.val ≤ z.val

name: Complexity.Planar.graphEdge_div
statement:
theorem graphEdge_div {n : Nat} {edge : Fin n → Fin n} (h : IsGraphEdge edge) (d : Fin n) :
    (edge d).val / 2 = d.val / 2

name: Complexity.Planar.graphEdge_val
statement:
theorem graphEdge_val {n : Nat} {edge : Fin n → Fin n} (h : IsGraphEdge edge) (d : Fin n) :
    (d.val % 2 = 0 ∧ (edge d).val = d.val + 1) ∨ (d.val % 2 = 1 ∧ (edge d).val = d.val - 1)

name: Complexity.Planar.length_le_countP
statement:
theorem length_le_countP {n : Nat} (P : Fin n → Bool) (xs : List (Fin n)) (hnd : xs.Nodup)
    (hP : ∀ x ∈ xs, P x = true) : xs.length ≤ (List.finRange n).countP P

name: Complexity.Planar.map_val_finRange
statement: theorem map_val_finRange (n : Nat) : (List.finRange n).map Fin.val = List.range n

name: Complexity.Planar.nodup_of_map
statement: theorem nodup_of_map {α β : Type} (f : α → β) {l : List α} (h : (l.map f).Nodup) : l.Nodup

name: Complexity.Planar.planar_iff
statement:
theorem planar_iff {n : Nat} (G : Hypermap n) :
    G.Planar ↔ 2 * G.componentCount + n ≤ G.eulerRhs + 1

name: Complexity.Planar.planar_of_bounds
statement:
theorem planar_of_bounds {n : Nat} (G : Hypermap n) (e v f c : Nat)
    (he : e ≤ cycleCount G.edge) (hv : v ≤ cycleCount G.node) (hf : f ≤ cycleCount G.face)
    (hc : G.componentCount ≤ c) (h : 2 * c + n ≤ e + v + f + 1) : G.Planar

name: Complexity.iterate_add
statement:
theorem iterate_add {α : Type} (f : α → α) (a b : Nat) (x : α) :
    iterate f (a + b) x = iterate f b (iterate f a x)

name: Complexity.iterate_invariant
statement:
theorem iterate_invariant {α β : Type} (f : α → α) (φ : α → β) (h : ∀ x, φ (f x) = φ x)
    (k : Nat) (x : α) : φ (iterate f k x) = φ x

name: Complexity.iterate_succ'
statement:
theorem iterate_succ' {α : Type} (f : α → α) (k : Nat) (x : α) :
    iterate f (k + 1) x = f (iterate f k x)

name: Complexity.Planar.EmbedOK.component_count
statement:
theorem EmbedOK.component_count :
    h.hypermap.componentCount ≤ t.cC (2 * t.n2)

name: Complexity.Planar.EmbedOK.exists_hypermap
statement:
theorem EmbedOK.exists_hypermap {V : Type} {es : List (V × V)} {t : EmbedTables}
    (h : EmbedOK t) (dec : Nat → V) (hdec : ∀ a b, dec a = dec b → a = b)
    (hends : ∀ d, d < 2 * t.n2 → halfEdgeEnd es d = some (dec (t.EN d))) :
    ∃ G : Hypermap (2 * t.n2),
      (∀ d, (G.edge d).val = cond (Nat.beq (d.val % 2) 0) (d.val + 1) (d.val - 1)) ∧
      (∀ d d', (∃ k, iterate G.node k d = d') ↔
        halfEdgeEnd es d.val = halfEdgeEnd es d'.val) ∧
      G.Planar

name: Complexity.Planar.EmbedOK.face_count
statement: theorem EmbedOK.face_count : t.cF (2 * t.n2) ≤ cycleCount h.hypermap.face

name: Complexity.Planar.EmbedOK.from_root
statement:
theorem EmbedOK.from_root : ∀ r d, t.R d = r → d < 2 * t.n2 →
    ∃ z, z < 2 * t.n2 ∧ t.R z = 0 ∧ t.EN z = t.EN d ∧ iterate t.N r z = d

name: Complexity.Planar.EmbedOK.isGraphEdge
statement: theorem EmbedOK.isGraphEdge : IsGraphEdge h.hypermap.edge

name: Complexity.Planar.EmbedOK.iterate_EN
statement:
theorem EmbedOK.iterate_EN (k : Nat) {d : Nat} (hd : d < 2 * t.n2) :
    t.EN (iterate t.N k d) = t.EN d

name: Complexity.Planar.EmbedOK.iterate_N_lt
statement:
theorem EmbedOK.iterate_N_lt (k : Nat) {d : Nat} (hd : d < 2 * t.n2) :
    iterate t.N k d < 2 * t.n2

name: Complexity.Planar.EmbedOK.iterate_face
statement:
theorem EmbedOK.iterate_face (k : Nat) (d : Fin (2 * t.n2)) :
    (iterate h.hypermap.face k d).val = iterate t.F k d.val

name: Complexity.Planar.EmbedOK.iterate_node
statement:
theorem EmbedOK.iterate_node (k : Nat) (d : Fin (2 * t.n2)) :
    (iterate h.hypermap.node k d).val = iterate t.N k d.val

name: Complexity.Planar.EmbedOK.node_count
statement: theorem EmbedOK.node_count : t.cR (2 * t.n2) ≤ cycleCount h.hypermap.node

name: Complexity.Planar.EmbedOK.orbit
statement:
theorem EmbedOK.orbit {d d' : Nat} (hd : d < 2 * t.n2) (hd' : d' < 2 * t.n2)
    (hE : t.EN d = t.EN d') : ∃ k, iterate t.N k d = d'

name: Complexity.Planar.EmbedOK.planarGraph
statement:
theorem EmbedOK.planarGraph {V : Type} {es : List (V × V)} {t : EmbedTables} (h : EmbedOK t)
    (hlen : es.length = t.n2) (dec : Nat → V) (hdec : ∀ a b, dec a = dec b → a = b)
    (hends : ∀ d, d < 2 * t.n2 → halfEdgeEnd es d = some (dec (t.EN d))) :
    PlanarGraph es

name: Complexity.Planar.EmbedOK.pred_spec
statement:
theorem EmbedOK.pred_spec {d : Nat} (hd : d < 2 * t.n2) :
    t.F (ed d) < 2 * t.n2 ∧ t.N (t.F (ed d)) = d ∧ t.EN (t.F (ed d)) = t.EN d ∧
      (0 < t.R d → t.R (t.F (ed d)) + 1 = t.R d)

name: Complexity.Planar.EmbedOK.step_linked
statement:
theorem EmbedOK.step_linked {d s : Nat} (hd : d < 2 * t.n2) (hs : s < 2 * t.n2)
    (hstep : s = ed d ∨ s = t.N d ∨ s = t.F d) :
    h.hypermap.linked 1 ⟨d, hd⟩ ⟨s, hs⟩ = true

name: Complexity.Planar.EmbedOK.to_component
statement:
theorem EmbedOK.to_component : ∀ k d (hd : d < 2 * t.n2), t.D d = k →
    ∃ hc : t.CL d < 2 * t.n2, h.hypermap.linked k ⟨d, hd⟩ ⟨t.CL d, hc⟩ = true

name: Complexity.Planar.EmbedOK.to_root
statement:
theorem EmbedOK.to_root : ∀ s d, 2 * t.n2 - t.R d = s → d < 2 * t.n2 →
    ∃ k z, z < 2 * t.n2 ∧ t.R z = 0 ∧ t.EN z = t.EN d ∧ iterate t.N k d = z

name: Complexity.Planar.decodeEnd_injective
statement: theorem decodeEnd_injective {a b : Nat} (h : decodeEnd a = decodeEnd b) : a = b

name: Complexity.Planar.ed_even
statement: theorem ed_even (h : Nat) : ed (2 * h) = 2 * h + 1

name: Complexity.Planar.ed_odd
statement: theorem ed_odd (h : Nat) : ed (2 * h + 1) = 2 * h

name: Complexity.Planar.nodup_filter_finRange
statement:
theorem nodup_filter_finRange (n : Nat) (P : Fin n → Bool) :
    ((List.finRange n).filter P).Nodup

name: Complexity.Planar.nodup_map_of_injOn
statement:
theorem nodup_map_of_injOn {α β : Type} (f : α → β) {l : List α} (hl : l.Nodup)
    (hf : ∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b ∈ l, f a = f b → a = b) : (l.map f).Nodup

name: Complexity.Planar.runningCount
statement:
theorem runningCount (c : Nat → Nat) (P : Nat → Bool) (N : Nat) (h0 : c 0 = 0)
    (hs : ∀ d, d < N → c (d + 1) = c d + (if P d then 1 else 0)) :
    c N = (List.finRange N).countP (fun x => P x.val)

name: Complexity.Planar.back
statement:
theorem back (hp : ∀ a b, p a = p b → a = b) (k : Nat) (x : Fin n) :
    ∃ r, iterate p r (iterate p k x) = x

name: Complexity.Planar.cmin_eq_iff
statement:
theorem cmin_eq_iff (hp : ∀ a b, p a = p b → a = b) (x : Fin n) :
    cmin p x = x ↔ CycleMin p x = true

name: Complexity.Planar.cmin_iterate
statement:
theorem cmin_iterate (hp : ∀ a b, p a = p b → a = b) (x : Fin n) (k : Nat) :
    cmin p (iterate p k x) = cmin p x

name: Complexity.Planar.cmin_le
statement:
theorem cmin_le (hp : ∀ a b, p a = p b → a = b) (x : Fin n) (k : Nat) :
    (cmin p x).val ≤ (iterate p k x).val

name: Complexity.Planar.cmin_le_self
statement: theorem cmin_le_self (hp : ∀ a b, p a = p b → a = b) (x : Fin n) : (cmin p x).val ≤ x.val

name: Complexity.Planar.cmin_mem
statement: theorem cmin_mem (x : Fin n) : ∃ i, i < n ∧ iterate p i x = cmin p x

name: Complexity.Planar.cmin_step
statement: theorem cmin_step (hp : ∀ a b, p a = p b → a = b) (x : Fin n) : cmin p (p x) = cmin p x

name: Complexity.Planar.crank_lt
statement: theorem crank_lt (hp : ∀ a b, p a = p b → a = b) (x : Fin n) : crank p hp x < n

name: Complexity.Planar.crank_pred
statement:
theorem crank_pred (hp : ∀ a b, p a = p b → a = b) (q x : Fin n) (hq : p q = x)
    (hpos : 0 < crank p hp x) : crank p hp q + 1 = crank p hp x

name: Complexity.Planar.crank_spec
statement:
theorem crank_spec (hp : ∀ a b, p a = p b → a = b) (x : Fin n) :
    iterate p (crank p hp x) (cmin p x) = x ∧
      ∀ r, r < crank p hp x → iterate p r (cmin p x) ≠ x

name: Complexity.Planar.crank_step
statement:
theorem crank_step (hp : ∀ a b, p a = p b → a = b) (x : Fin n) :
    crank p hp (p x) = crank p hp x + 1 ∨ crank p hp (p x) = 0

name: Complexity.Planar.crank_zero_iff
statement:
theorem crank_zero_iff (hp : ∀ a b, p a = p b → a = b) (x : Fin n) :
    crank p hp x = 0 ↔ cmin p x = x

name: Complexity.Planar.exists_cycleMin
statement:
theorem exists_cycleMin (x : Fin n) :
    ∃ z : Fin n, (∃ i, i < n ∧ iterate p i x = z) ∧
      ∀ i, i < n → z.val ≤ (iterate p i x).val

name: Complexity.Planar.exists_least
statement: theorem exists_least {P : Nat → Prop} (h : ∃ r, P r) : ∃ r, P r ∧ ∀ r', r' < r → ¬ P r'

name: Complexity.Planar.from_cmin
statement:
theorem from_cmin (hp : ∀ a b, p a = p b → a = b) (x : Fin n) :
    ∃ r, iterate p r (cmin p x) = x

name: Complexity.Planar.hm_edge_inj
statement: theorem hm_edge_inj : ∀ a b, G.edge a = G.edge b → a = b

name: Complexity.Planar.hm_edge_surj
statement: theorem hm_edge_surj (y : Fin n) : ∃ x, G.edge x = y

name: Complexity.Planar.hm_face_inj
statement: theorem hm_face_inj : ∀ a b, G.face a = G.face b → a = b

name: Complexity.Planar.hm_linked_first
statement:
theorem hm_linked_first {k : Nat} {x y : Fin n} (h : G.linked (k + 1) x y = true) :
    G.linked k x y = true ∨ ∃ s, Linked.Step G x s ∧ G.linked k s y = true

name: Complexity.Planar.hm_linked_symm
statement:
theorem hm_linked_symm {k : Nat} {x y : Fin n} (h : G.linked k x y = true) :
    ∃ k', G.linked k' y x = true

name: Complexity.Planar.hm_node_inj
statement: theorem hm_node_inj : ∀ a b, G.node a = G.node b → a = b

name: Complexity.Planar.hm_step_back
statement: theorem hm_step_back {x s : Fin n} (h : Linked.Step G x s) : ∃ k, G.linked k s x = true

name: Complexity.Planar.iterate_inj
statement:
theorem iterate_inj (hp : ∀ a b, p a = p b → a = b) (k : Nat) {a b : Fin n}
    (h : iterate p k a = iterate p k b) : a = b

name: Complexity.Planar.iterate_mod
statement:
theorem iterate_mod (hp : ∀ a b, p a = p b → a = b) (x : Fin n) (k : Nat) :
    ∃ i, i < n ∧ iterate p k x = iterate p i x

name: Complexity.Planar.iterate_period_mul
statement:
theorem iterate_period_mul (x : Fin n) (T : Nat) (hT : iterate p T x = x) (c : Nat) :
    iterate p (c * T) x = x

name: Complexity.Planar.nodup_map_of_injOn'
statement:
theorem nodup_map_of_injOn' {α β : Type} (f : α → β) {l : List α} (hl : l.Nodup)
    (hf : ∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b ∈ l, f a = f b → a = b) : (l.map f).Nodup

name: Complexity.Planar.period
statement:
theorem period (hp : ∀ a b, p a = p b → a = b) (x : Fin n) :
    ∃ T, 0 < T ∧ T ≤ n ∧ iterate p T x = x

name: Complexity.Planar.pigeonhole
statement: theorem pigeonhole {n : Nat} (g : Nat → Fin n) : ∃ i j, i < j ∧ j ≤ n ∧ g i = g j

name: Complexity.Planar.surj
statement: theorem surj (hp : ∀ a b, p a = p b → a = b) (y : Fin n) : ∃ x, p x = y

name: Complexity.Planar.compMin_lt
statement: theorem compMin_lt (x : Fin n) : compMin G x < n

name: Complexity.Planar.compMin_spec
statement:
theorem compMin_spec (x : Fin n) :
    (∃ y : Fin n, y.val = compMin G x ∧ G.linked n x y = true) ∧
      ∀ y : Fin n, G.linked n x y = true → compMin G x ≤ y.val

name: Complexity.Planar.compMin_step
statement: theorem compMin_step {x s : Fin n} (hs : Linked.Step G x s) : compMin G s = compMin G x

name: Complexity.Planar.depth_le
statement: theorem depth_le (x : Fin n) : depth G x ≤ n

name: Complexity.Planar.depth_spec
statement:
theorem depth_spec (x : Fin n) :
    G.linked (depth G x) x ⟨compMin G x, compMin_lt G x⟩ = true ∧
      ∀ k', k' < depth G x → ¬ G.linked k' x ⟨compMin G x, compMin_lt G x⟩ = true

name: Complexity.Planar.depth_zero_iff
statement: theorem depth_zero_iff (x : Fin n) : depth G x = 0 ↔ compMin G x = x.val

name: Complexity.Planar.embed_complete
statement:
theorem embed_complete {V : Type} {es : List (V × V)} (enc : V → Nat) (dec : Nat → V)
    (hde : ∀ v, dec (enc v) = v) (hp : PlanarGraph es) :
    ∃ t : EmbedTables, t.n2 = es.length ∧ EmbedOK t ∧
      (∀ d, d < 2 * t.n2 → ∃ v, halfEdgeEnd es d = some v ∧ t.EN d = enc v) ∧
      (∀ d, d < 2 * t.n2 → t.N d < 2 * t.n2 ∧ t.F d < 2 * t.n2 ∧ t.R d < 2 * t.n2 ∧
        t.FL d ≤ d ∧ t.CL d ≤ d ∧ t.D d ≤ 2 * t.n2 ∧ t.SU d < 2 * t.n2) ∧
      (∀ d, t.cR d ≤ d ∧ t.cF d ≤ d ∧ t.cC d ≤ d) ∧
      (∀ d, 2 * t.n2 ≤ d → t.EN d = 0 ∧ t.N d = 0 ∧ t.F d = 0 ∧ t.R d = 0 ∧ t.FL d = 0 ∧
        t.CL d = 0 ∧ t.D d = 0 ∧ t.SU d = 0)

name: Complexity.Planar.exists_compMin
statement:
theorem exists_compMin (x : Fin n) :
    ∃ k, (∃ y : Fin n, y.val = k ∧ G.linked n x y = true) ∧
      ∀ k', k' < k → ¬ ∃ y : Fin n, y.val = k' ∧ G.linked n x y = true

name: Complexity.Planar.exists_depth
statement:
theorem exists_depth (x : Fin n) :
    ∃ k, (G.linked k x ⟨compMin G x, compMin_lt G x⟩ = true) ∧
      ∀ k', k' < k → ¬ G.linked k' x ⟨compMin G x, compMin_lt G x⟩ = true

name: Complexity.Planar.exists_succ
statement:
theorem exists_succ (x : Fin n) (hpos : 0 < depth G x) :
    ∃ s : Fin n, Linked.Step G x s ∧
      G.linked (depth G x - 1) s ⟨compMin G x, compMin_lt G x⟩ = true

name: Complexity.Planar.linked_step_iff
statement:
theorem linked_step_iff {x s : Fin n} (hs : Linked.Step G x s) (y : Fin n) :
    G.linked n x y = true ↔ G.linked n s y = true

name: Complexity.Planar.natOf_lt
statement: theorem natOf_lt (f : Fin n → Nat) {d : Nat} (h : d < n) : natOf f d = f ⟨d, h⟩

name: Complexity.Planar.runCount_le
statement: theorem runCount_le (P : Nat → Bool) (d : Nat) : runCount P d ≤ d

name: Complexity.Planar.runCount_succ
statement:
theorem runCount_succ (P : Nat → Bool) (d : Nat) :
    runCount P (d + 1) = runCount P d + (if P d then 1 else 0)

name: Complexity.Planar.succDart_spec
statement:
theorem succDart_spec (x : Fin n) (hpos : 0 < depth G x) :
    ∃ hs : succDart G x < n, Linked.Step G x ⟨succDart G x, hs⟩ ∧
      depth G ⟨succDart G x, hs⟩ + 1 = depth G x ∧
      compMin G ⟨succDart G x, hs⟩ = compMin G x

name: Complexity.Planar.getD_eq
statement: theorem getD_eq (p : Nat) (hp : p < l.length) : l.getD p 0 = l[p]

name: Complexity.Planar.idxOf_getElem
statement: theorem idxOf_getElem (hl : l.Nodup) {p : Nat} (hp : p < l.length) : l.idxOf l[p] = p

name: Complexity.Planar.iterate_rnext
statement:
theorem iterate_rnext (hl : l.Nodup) {p : Nat} (hp : p < l.length) (k : Nat) :
    iterate (rnext l) k l[p] = l[(p + k) % l.length]'(Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))

name: Complexity.Planar.mem_getElem
statement: theorem mem_getElem {d : Nat} (hd : d ∈ l) : ∃ p, ∃ hp : p < l.length, l[p] = d

name: Complexity.Planar.rnext_getElem
statement:
theorem rnext_getElem (hl : l.Nodup) {p : Nat} (hp : p < l.length) :
    rnext l l[p] = l[(p + 1) % l.length]'(Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))

name: Complexity.Planar.rnext_mem
statement: theorem rnext_mem {d : Nat} (hl : l.Nodup) (hd : d ∈ l) : rnext l d ∈ l

name: Complexity.Planar.rnext_reach
statement:
theorem rnext_reach {d d' : Nat} (hl : l.Nodup) (hd : d ∈ l) (hd' : d' ∈ l) :
    ∃ k, iterate (rnext l) k d = d'

name: Complexity.Planar.rnext_rprev
statement: theorem rnext_rprev {d : Nat} (hl : l.Nodup) (hd : d ∈ l) : rnext l (rprev l d) = d

name: Complexity.Planar.rprev_getElem
statement:
theorem rprev_getElem (hl : l.Nodup) {p : Nat} (hp : p < l.length) :
    rprev l l[p] = l[(p + l.length - 1) % l.length]'(Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))

name: Complexity.Planar.rprev_mem
statement: theorem rprev_mem {d : Nat} (hl : l.Nodup) (hd : d ∈ l) : rprev l d ∈ l

name: Complexity.Planar.rprev_rnext
statement: theorem rprev_rnext {d : Nat} (hl : l.Nodup) (hd : d ∈ l) : rprev l (rnext l d) = d
